palette.sky: #0A1418 ground-ink night to #14303A spruce-night, dawning to #6F94A6 snow-blue by the button
palette.hero: #B58A3C brass SeismicStation horn and #F2B04A tungsten lamp
palette.mood: 3 a.m. cabin-and-muskeg night under one tungsten practical, warming to paper-and-dawn as the slip fills

roles.tungsten #F2B04A: the one motivated key light: the cabin lamp, the SeismicStation lamp, lit dots. Never fills a large area.
roles.chalk #EDE6D3: the Slip (thermal paper), dots, bracket, labels. Every paper object keeps a 2px ink keyline and sits against a dark plane.
roles.alarm red #E0453A: spent ONCE per frame and only on the printed weak spot (the taped rust line) and the 3:07 pip
roles.skeptic cool #8FB5C9: only the shot 8 pegboard and its two boards, and the Japan map plate and day dial, so the Test and the context read as a different air
roles.spruce #14303A: night ground, never behind chalk text at low contrast
roles.lit chartreuse #C8E04A: lit tiles and the single lit grain only, the one cool-warm accent that means counted

palette.diverges_from_last_two: 10-15 pearl fog daylight with cranberry; 10-11 first-light rose tundra. This is a black-spruce night with tungsten and chalk, no cranberry, no pearl.

light.time_of_day: 3:07 a.m. to first grey light at the button
light.direction: one tungsten practical lamp low left, cold window light from right
light.intent: key=tungsten lamp pool, fill=snow-blue window light at 25 percent, rim=chalk on the station horn
light.depth: Stage3D planes: near table/slip, mid station or board, far spruce ridge, haze; NightGrade over every exterior

shape_language: SOFT ROUND instrument (SeismicStation) and round dots against HARD ANGULAR land and a hard rectangular Slip: the question is round, the answer is a straight-edged receipt

casting.hero: SeismicStation (sensors.tsx, shelf, last hero 2026-07-25, not in the last two)
casting.throughline: the Slip: net-new thermal receipt strip in lib/odds.tsx, prints line by line, curls, takes a rust-taped line that peels, a clock box, a PENDING stamp
casting.supporting: OddsBoard 10x10 tiles, GrainBin, DialPanel, RangeSlots, Pegboard, ClockFace, MapPlate, CorkWall, Dominoes (no animal cast: the SeismicStation is the only face)
casting.net_new_reason: the shelf has no probability-as-count object or receipt; both are reusable (odds.tsx)

motion_language: nothing linear: slip prints with stepper stutter and curl, dots flip with a ripple and clack, tape peels about a pivot, clocks whip with overshoot; hero SeismicStation lamp and horn idle continuously (vitals)

composition.negative_space: the breather shot is 60 percent dark with a flat trace
composition.safe_area: hero action inside y 420 to 1500; plates clear of y 420, 1336 to 1472 caption band
composition.signature_shot: the tile board pulls back and up until it is one layer of ten in a glass bin of a thousand grains, one speck lit, and then three nested drawers slide out

craft_advance: none required; odds.tsx is a reusable probability-as-count kit
